hero.subtitle: CBI Tunisia delivers innovative composite manufacturing technologies, industrial production lines, and high-performance construction solutions for international markets.

about.lead: CBI Tunisia is a leading manufacturer and technology provider specializing in composite construction materials and industrial production systems. We design, engineer, and deploy advanced GFRP production lines for the world's most demanding construction and infrastructure projects.
about.expanded1: With over 12 years of deep industry expertise, our engineering teams specialize in GFRP rebar production lines, composite mesh manufacturing, bent elements, composite tanks, pipes, and structural profiles — providing complete turnkey solutions from concept through commissioning and ongoing technical support.
about.expanded2: Our commitment to precision engineering, continuous innovation, and rigorous quality assurance has earned CBI Tunisia the trust of manufacturers, engineering firms, and construction companies in over 40 countries.
about.bullet1: Turnkey GFRP production line design and installation
about.bullet2: Complete engineering, commissioning, and operator training
about.bullet3: In-house R&D team advancing composite material technology

productionLines.title: PRODUCTION LINES
productionLines.subtitle: Six specialized GFRP and composite manufacturing systems engineered for precision, scale, and global market demands.

rebar.title: GFRP Rebar
rebar.desc: High-throughput glass fiber reinforced polymer rebar manufacturing with automated winding and quality control systems.

mesh.title: GFRP Mesh
mesh.desc: Automated composite mesh weaving and assembly systems for construction-grade corrosion-free reinforcement panels.

bent.title: Bent Elements
bent.desc: Precision thermoforming and bending systems for GFRP stirrups, hooks, and custom-shaped composite reinforcement.

tank.title: Composite Tank
tank.desc: Filament winding production lines for corrosion-resistant FRP storage tanks from 1,000L to 5,000,000L capacity.

pipe.title: Composite Pipe
pipe.desc: GRE and GRP pipe manufacturing systems engineered for water, chemical, and industrial fluid transfer applications.

profiles.title: Composite Profiles
profiles.desc: Pultrusion production lines for structural composite profiles, beams, channels, and custom engineering sections.

applications.title: INDUSTRY APPLICATIONS
applications.subtitle: CBI Tunisia's composite technologies enable durable, corrosion-free construction across all major sectors.

construction.title: Construction
construction.desc: GFRP rebar and composite mesh systems for residential, commercial, and high-rise construction requiring corrosion-free, long-life reinforcement.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.desc: Composite production technologies for tunnels, retaining walls, metro lines, and major public infrastructure projects worldwide.

roads.title: Roads & Bridges
roads.desc: Durable GFRP reinforcement for road decks, bridge structures, and elevated highways with superior load performance and corrosion resistance.

marine.title: Marine Engineering
marine.desc: Saltwater-resistant composite structures for ports, jetties, offshore platforms, and coastal infrastructure with extended service life.

industrial.title: Industrial Facilities
industrial.desc: Composite tanks, pipes, and structural systems for chemical plants, processing facilities, and demanding manufacturing environments.

water.title: Water Management
water.desc: FRP tanks, pipes, and distribution systems for potable water treatment, wastewater management, and large-scale irrigation networks.
